value.title: Partial fill preserves the residual duty (present-positive, present-zero, absent stay distinct)

parameters.d: duty slot (debtor, creditor, asset a, due D)

value.predicate: From pre-state (present=1, amount=D), partial(p): if 0 < p < D then post is (present=1, D-p) and a creditor payout of p exists (CAP-E-003); if p = D then post is (present=1, 0), i.e. present-zero, not absent; if p > D the action refuses (no clamping). Present to absent only through an explicit termination action carrying a universal certificate that no present duty is dropped.
value.quantifiers: For all duty slots touched by the action
value.contextAuthenticator: Datum continuity (CAP-E-001) for the ledger anchor of C_pre and C_post
value.proposedConstruction: Per-slot constraint (1-presence)*amount = 0, enforced in the circuit or validator, plus the payout check
value.firstBlocker: Datum and commitment encoding that keeps absent distinct from present-zero
value.implementation: K2 compiled P02 partial (descriptor A: 308790 constraints). Unreviewed. Duty-slot constraints are not established by counts.

value.verifierDeploymentMapping: Thread validator, optionally with a Groth16 proof over descriptor A after setup
